releases.raw_summary:
NoteIntroduces a Flask OCR API proxied by Nginx, updates the Windows deploy workflow to run init and restart the Flask service, and adds supporting scripts/config with version/docs updates.

Backend/API:

Add Flask OCR service (suh-ai-server/flask/*): health//ocr endpoints (app.py), OCR logic (ocr_service.py), prod runner (run.py), deps (requirements.txt), tests/docs.
Add PowerShell OCR client script suh-ai-server/data/ollama-OCR.ps1.


Nginx (suh-ai-server/config/nginx.conf):

Add python_backend upstream and route location /api/flask/ with API-key auth, rate limiting, rewrites, and proxy settings.
Introduce python_limit rate zone; keep global auth/rate limiting; public /health retained.


CI/CD (.github/workflows/SUH-AI-PROJECT-CONTROL.yaml):

Inject API keys into nginx.conf, SCP sync to Windows, run deploy-init.ps1, apply Nginx, and restart Flask via deploy-flask.ps1.


Scripts:

Add suh-ai-server/scripts/deploy-flask.ps1 to manage Flask service with NSSM.


Housekeeping:

Extend .gitignore for Python artifacts.
Update CHANGELOG.md/CHANGELOG.json, README.md (version), and bump version.yml to 1.1.25/code 30.

CI/CD

Add GitHub Actions workflow /.github/workflows/SUH-AI-PROJECT-CONTROL.yaml to deploy to Windows: inject API keys into suh-ai-server/config/nginx.conf, SCP sync, run scripts/deploy.ps1 and scripts/deploy-nginx.ps1.


Server config (Nginx)

Overhaul suh-ai-server/config/nginx.conf: switch to map-based X-API-Key auth with injected keys, define public endpoints (/health, /api/tunnel-info), enable rate limiting, listen on 0.0.0.0:11435; remove file/Lua-based auth paths.


Scripts

Add suh-ai-server/scripts/deploy.ps1 (download/deploy preserving injected nginx.conf) and deploy-nginx.ps1 (validate/reload Nginx).
Add suh-ai-server/scripts/startup.bat to start Ollama and Nginx.
Remove legacy Windows scripts and API helpers (e.g., api/generate-api-key.ps1, api/health-check.ps1, various scripts/*.bat).


Networking

Update bin/suh_ai_proxy_manager.sh: add Python server forwarding 11436 → 172.30.1.14:11436 to setup/remove/status/usage.


Docs/Versioning

Bump versions (version.yml to 1.1.18/code 23), update README.md latest version, refresh CHANGELOG.md/CHANGELOG.json.
